turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We noticed you downgraded your plan last month — can you share why?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Budget cuts on our side more than dissatisfaction, honestly. We loved the product but our audiobook division got its budget slashed for the quarter.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The character pricing didn't help — at our old volume it was a meaningful line item, so it was an easy first cut when the budget review happened.
